_note_scope: Static ego-vehicle configuration. Constant across ALL scenes. Anything that varies per run (target speed, spawn point, seeds) belongs in scene_description.json instead.

ego_vehicle._note: Sedan, per the Phase 0 scope lock. Deliberately FIXED across every scene: swapping the ego between runs changes camera height and mounting geometry, which shifts the whole data distribution. That is a confound, not useful diversity.

sensor_rig._note: Front-focused MVP rig, per the Phase 0 hero (forward-driving: lead-vehicle distance + speed signs ahead). Designed so 5 additional cameras can be added later without a schema change.
sensor_rig._extrinsic_convention: T_sensor_to_ego - sensor pose expressed in the ego frame. See coordinate_conventions in CARLA_config.json.

cam_front._note: Intrinsics (fx, fy, cx, cy) are DERIVED from width/height/fov, not stored: fx = fy = width / (2 * tan(fov/2)); cx = width/2; cy = height/2. Storing both invites drift.

cam_front_instance_seg._note: MUST share intrinsics/extrinsics with cam_front so per-actor ID pixels align with projected boxes. Drives the VEHICLE visibility filter (Phase 1 step 8.iii).

cam_front_depth._note: Drives the SIGN occlusion check. Signs are static map objects with no actor instance ID, so instance-seg cannot filter them - compare the sign's projected distance against the depth buffer instead.

lidar_top._note: rotation_frequency MUST equal world_settings.sim_hz (20) so exactly one full sweep completes per tick. Mismatch gives partial or duplicated sweeps. This is the primary source for lead-vehicle distance.

imu._note: Ego-state, NOT a perception input. The detector never sees this. Recorded for ego-motion in tracking (Phase 0 supporting task).

gnss._note: Ego-state, NOT a perception input. See imu note.
